svg.title: ICD-10-CM: the compact knowledge graph
svg.desc: Seven categories, all 41 subcategories and all 21,110 selected fact marks. Counts show selected facts versus complete FFL facts. Predicate groups and exact facts are in the compact graph CSVs.
svg.text: All extracted facts stay in FFL. Explore up to 1,000 selected facts in every subcategory.
